name: NC Office of Administrative Hearings

plan.title: NC Office of Administrative Hearings Strategic Plan 2025-2029

mission.text: To serve the citizens of North Carolina with integrity, quality, and efficiency by providing an independent, neutral forum for the prompt and impartial resolution of contested cases.

citation.document: NC Office of Administrative Hearings Strategic Plan 2025-2029

program_priorities: Hearings: correct decisions within statutory requirements

objectives.goal_title: Hearings: correct decisions within statutory requirements
objectives.text: Issue contested case decisions consistent with statutory and case law.

citation.document: NC Office of Administrative Hearings Strategic Plan 2025-2029

objectives.text: Dispose of 90% of Medicaid contested cases within 90 days, within federal and statutory deadlines.

citation.document: NC Office of Administrative Hearings Strategic Plan 2025-2029

objectives.text: Publish agency rules on time, support Rules Review Commission review and provide rulemaking training.

citation.document: NC Office of Administrative Hearings Strategic Plan 2025-2029

objectives.text: Investigate Title VII, Title VIII, ADEA, GINA and ADA discrimination charges promptly and consistently.

citation.document: NC Office of Administrative Hearings Strategic Plan 2025-2029

objectives.text: Provide fair employment and fair housing training to Human Relations Commissioners, staff and the public.

citation.document: NC Office of Administrative Hearings Strategic Plan 2025-2029

wording_note: Goals and objectives are close summaries of the plan posted on the OSBM Agency Strategic Plans page (retrieved 2026-11-07); check the cited section before quoting. Keywords, search terms and usual funders were chosen by the team as matching aids.
